## Checklist

- [ ] No panel data, secrets, or raw identifiers added.
- [ ] January-only fitting preserved; February used only for labels.

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Docs updated (API, model card, data card, or protocol).
